title: Healthy skull mask: sections, context and display cutaway
author: NeuroImage project
objective: Inspect the unchanged source mask and native surface while distinguishing source openings, display clipping and unavailable original CT evidence.

scenes.title: Complete source-mask context
scenes.prompt: Inspect complete categorical sections and the whole source surface. Locate the section within the full head before examining a local opening.
scenes.note: Original healthy A0101 binary skull mask, retaining the supplied components and noise. This package represents categorical skull sampling; CT intensity and named foraminal coverage are separate source-development items. Stored axial spacing is 0.75 mm, while the publication reports 1.5 mm cohort slice thickness. Apparent openings and asymmetries are observations for separate anatomical assessment.

image_anchor.label: Complete source-mask context
image_anchor.reference: Li J et al. MUG500+: Database of 500 high-resolution healthy human skulls and 29 craniotomy skulls and implants. Data in Brief 39:107524 (2021). doi:10.1016/j.dib.2021.107524. Only healthy skull A0101 is used. Dataset doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.9616319.v20. https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/MUG500_Repository/9616319/20
